meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE whenever a task needs a commit or git-history investigation. Covers atomic commits, staging, commit-message style, rebase, squash, fixup/autosquash, blame, bisect, reflog, git log -S/-G, and questions like who wrote this or when was this added. Do not use for ordinary code edits unless the user asks for git work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理 Git 提交与历史，自动生成规范提交
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要规范提交或排查 Git 历史
copy.tagline_en: Manage Git commits and history with automated commit messages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to make clean commits or investigate Git history

howto.what: 装好后，当你要求操作 Git 历史或询问历史问题时，Claude 会按照项目管理代码提交、变基、查找变更来源等，并给出精确的 Git 命令证据。
howto.when: 当你要求进行 Git 提交、查看历史、变基、还原等操作，或询问代码是谁改的、何时改的时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个功能的改动提交成一个整洁的 commit。
say.note: Claude 会自动识别相关文件并分组提交。

say.text: 看看这个文件是谁修改的，以及具体改动。
say.note: Claude 会运行 blame 并给出证据。

say.text: 帮我用 squash 合并最近的两个提交。
say.note: Claude 会执行变基并交互压缩。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude specializes in git commit and history investigation: atomic commits, rebase, squash, blame, bisect, reflog, and providing exact command evidence.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to commit, view history, rebase, or inquire about who changed what or when in the repo.

say_en.text: Commit these changes for me in a clean commit.
say_en.note: Claude will group related files and commit.

say_en.text: Who last modified this file and what changed?
say_en.note: Claude will run blame and show evidence.

say_en.text: Squash the last two commits for me.
say_en.note: Claude will rebase and squash interactively.
